query:
-- Criar link personalizado para Jenifer Borges
INSERT INTO personalized_links (student_id, link_hash, expires_at, is_active, created_at)
SELECT id, SHA2(CONCAT(id, NOW(), RAND()), 256), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 MONTH), 1, NOW()
FROM users WHERE email = 'jenifer.borges@influx.com.br';
